name: Ape Shaman
summary: A shaman with this totem calls upon the mighty ape, a peaceful but powerful simian whose strength is beyond compare.

features.name: Nature Bond
features.summary: An ape shaman who chooses an animal companion must select an ape or related primate. If choosing a domain, the ape shaman must choose from the Animal, Community (Family subdomain), Destruction (Rage subdomain), and Strength domains.

features.name: Wild Empathy (Ex)
features.summary: An ape shaman can use wild empathy with apes and other primates as a full-round action with a +4 bonus.

features.name: Totem Transformation (Su)
features.summary: At 2nd level, an ape shaman may adopt an aspect of the ape while retaining her normal form. The druid gains one of the following sets of bonuses and abilities: movement (climb speed 20 ft., +4 racial bonus on Climb checks), senses (low-light vision, scent), natural weapons (2 slams [1d6 for a Medium shaman], +2 on combat maneuver checks to grapple), or toughness (+2 natural armor bonus to AC, Endurance feat). While using totem transformation, the ape shaman may speak normally and can cast speak with animals (primates only) at will. Using this ability is a standard action at 2nd level, a move action at 7th level, and a swift action at 12th level. The ape shaman can use this ability for a number of minutes per day equal to her druid level. These minutes do not need to be consecutive, but they must be used in 1-minute increments. This is a polymorph effect and cannot be used while the druid is using another polymorph effect, such as wild shape. This ability replaces woodland stride.

resourceActions.label: Activate Totem Transformation

modes.label: Movement
modes.summary: Gain a 20-foot climb speed. +4 racial bonus on Climb checks.

modes.label: Natural weapons
modes.summary: Gain two slam attacks (1d6 for Medium) and +2 CMB to grapple.

activeEffects.label: Ape natural weapons
activeEffects.description: Gain two slam attacks (1d6 for Medium) and +2 CMB to grapple.

modes.label: Toughness
modes.summary: +2 natural armor bonus to AC. Gain Endurance while this aspect is active.

activeEffects.label: Endurance
activeEffects.description: Gain Endurance while this aspect is active.

resourceActions.summary: Spend 1 minute of Totem Transformation and apply the selected aspect for 10 rounds.

resourceActions.label: Speak with primates

confirmations.label: The target is one of the permitted primates

resourceActions.summary: At-will speak with animals, restricted to primates.

features.name: Totemic Summons (Su)
features.summary: At 5th level, an ape shaman may cast summon nature’s ally as a standard action when summoning primates, and these summoned creatures gain temporary hit points equal to her druid level. She can apply the young template to any primate to reduce the level of the summoning spell required by one. She can also increase the level of summoning required by one in order to apply either the advanced or the giant template, or increase it by two to apply both the advanced and giant templates. This ability replaces a thousand faces.

resourceActions.label: Resolve Totemic Summons

modes.label: Young (spell level -1)
modes.summary: Apply the young template and reduce the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Normal
modes.summary: Use the normal summon spell level.

modes.label: Advanced (spell level +1)
modes.summary: Apply the advanced template and increase the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Giant (spell level +1)
modes.summary: Apply the giant template and increase the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Advanced + giant (spell level +2)
modes.summary: Apply both templates and increase the required summon spell level by 2.

activeEffect.name: Ape Shaman Totemic Summons
activeEffect.description: Summoned primates gain temporary hit points equal to your druid level; track their summon duration separately.

resourceActions.summary: Cast summon nature's ally as a standard action for primates; summoned creatures gain temporary hit points equal to druid level.

features.name: Wild Shape (Su)
features.summary: At 6th level, an ape shaman’s wild shape ability functions at her druid level –2. If she takes on the form of an ape, she instead uses her druid level +2. This ability replaces wild shape.

activeEffects.description: Resolve wild shape at druid level +2.

activeEffects.label: Adjusted wild shape
activeEffects.description: Resolve wild shape at druid level -2.

progressionProfiles.summary: Effective druid levels used by normal and totem-favored wild shape forms.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: At 9th level and every four levels thereafter, an ape shaman gains one of the following bonus feats: Diehard, Endurance, Great Fortitude, Improved Bull Rush, and Toughness. She must meet the prerequisites for these bonus feats. This ability replaces venom immunity.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: At 13th level, an ape shaman gains another feat from her totem bonus feat list.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: At 17th level, an ape shaman gains another feat from her totem bonus feat list.

mechanicalNotes: Nature Bond restrictions, Wild Empathy, daily transformation minutes, aspect modes, at-will animal speech, template-aware summons, effective wild-shape levels, and all bonus-feat slots are automated.
